passive.name: Carnivore
passive.description: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

spells.description: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing true damage to champions or to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain max Health. Only stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.
